axis_conversion.cep: muB_CEP_MeV is used directly when present; otherwise muB_MeV = 3 * muq_CEP_MeV

visual_connector_policy.Trho_CEP: Plotting-only connector rows are added to the T-rho figure asset so that the coexistence branches and crossover curve visually pass through the CEP. The formal source data remain unchanged.
visual_connector_policy.CEP_rho_coordinate: mean boundary density at the nearest available boundary temperature for the same xi

source_manifest_residual_risks: C2 refined check covers anchor xi values rather than a full refined xi grid.
Crossover rho and derivative diagnostics have larger relative differences at some high-order points; core T-muB phase-line observables remain stable.
Spinodal layer is production data but should remain optional in default figure design.
